content:
Sophie L.: taking the 18:00-02:00 UTC handoff. I'm primary for this shift, Jamie K. is secondary. Quick summary up front: active alerts for EMBEDS-ETL-QUEUE (p99 latency spike), KV-EVICTIONS-EU (eviction rate > 3%), and intermittent 502s on /v1/generate in eu-west. Customer impact: AcmeCorp is showing degraded throughput (high priority), a handful of other customers see elevated errors. See notes below.

incidents-bot: Pager EMBEDS-ETL-QUEUE fired 3m ago (alert: p99 > 1.2s).

oncall-bot: New deploy to embeds-service v1.14.3 completed 00:30 UTC — monitor for regressions.

Jamie K.: ack, I'm standing by as secondary. Do we have the rollback plan ready if deploy is correlated?

Sophie L.: yes — rollback playbook is below. First-line mitigations already run: scaled embeds pool, applied temporary rate cap for the EU weighty routes, disabled prefetch for customer routes to ease KV pressure.

Ravi P.: added some details — after scaling we saw ingestion queues drop from ~2.2k -> 700 in 8m, p99 dropped from ~1.6s -> ~0.95s but there are still spikes on certain shards. KV eviction rate dropped a bit but still oscillating. Logs show repeated backpressure warnings from model-runtime: 
```
WARN model-runtime: kv-cache eviction triggered shard=eu-12 rate=3.8% last_min=60s
ERROR embeds-worker: replica-3 got backpressure, queue_len=420
```

Mike O.: I turned on a temporary route filter to divert small traffic to fallback-quantized-model (lower throughput, higher latency but more stable). This is in place for routes: `/v1/generate?region=eu&priority=bulk`.

Sophie L.: actions performed (timestamps are relative to thread):
- scaled embeds-eu pool to 4 replicas (`redwoodctl pools scale --name embeds-eu --replicas 4`)
- applied route-level rate limit 30r/s to AcmeCorp's noncritical endpoints (`console -> routing -> policies -> acmecorp-ratecap`)
- disabled prefetch for `acquire_kv` path for 20 minutes (`feature-flag: prefetch_eu=false`)
- diverted bulk traffic to fallback model 
- opened a short customer-facing status note draft (needs review)

Jamie K.: good. Can you paste the rollback command for the deploy in case we must revert?

Sophie L.: rollback steps:
```bash
# rollback embeds-service to v1.14.1
deployctl rollback --svc embeds-service --to-tag v1.14.1 --confirm
# monitor after rollback
observability query "service:embeds-service p99(5m)"
```
If we decide to rollback, coordinate with eng-release (ping @Mike O.) and ensure we keep the scaled pool.

Ravi P.: additional troubleshooting notes:
- KV eviction hotspots concentrated on nodes eu-12 and eu-14 (see metrics).
- There are a couple of low-memory events on replica-3 that line up with higher eviction rates — suspect memory pressure from a new shard allocation.
- Suggest we patch LRU threshold up by 10% if evictions don't subside.

Sophie L.: runbook links and quick pointers:
- Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/embeds_latency (open this first)
- Eviction playbook: https://internal.redwood/eviction-playbook
- Escalation matrix: top-of-runbook -> if customer impact high, escalate to SRE lead (Ravi) and Eng Release (Mike).

incidents-bot: NOTE: Customer impact flagged HIGH for AcmeCorp. Pager escalation allowable to on-call SRE.

Jamie K.: I'll keep watch on logs and tracer spans. If p99 rises above 1.5s again, I will start the rollback procedure and notify customers.

Mike O.: FYI I pre-warmed an extra standby model on eu-west (quantized) so switching traffic is cheap. If we need to route more, tell me channel and I'll update the routing policy.

Sophie L.: short checklist for whoever's covering next 2 hours:
- confirm no further deploys into `embeds-service` without approval
- watch p50/p95/p99 on embeds and quantized-fallback for divergence
- monitor KV eviction rate and memory on eu-12 / eu-14 nodes
- keep AcmeCorp status updated (draft is at https://internal.redwood/status/INC-embeds-1729998888)
- if errors > 10% or p99 > 1.5s for 3 consecutive 5m windows -> escalate to SRE lead and trigger rollback

Ravi P.: I'll keep an eye on shader allocation and memory pressure, can take primary for kernel-level investigation if needed.

Jamie K.: @Sophie L. I'm ready to be primary if you need to step away for the next 45m. Also I'll run periodic smoke tests: `curl -sS https://eu.api.redwood/v1/generate?test=smoke` every 60s and post results here.

Sophie L.: thanks — handing main responsibility to Jamie for the next 45m while I grab dinner. I'll be reachable on slack and phone. Leaving the following quick status lines:
- current p99 embeds: ~0.95s (after scale)
- kv-eviction rate: 2.9% (was 3.8%)
- active pagers: EMBEDS-ETL-QUEUE (open), KV-EVICTIONS-EU (open)
- primary: Jamie K., secondary: Sophie L. (sits by for escalation), SRE lead: Ravi P., Release owner: Mike O.

Jamie K.: took it. I'll post 15m updates or sooner if anything changes.

Sophie L.: thanks team :thumbsup: — leaving detailed notes in the runbook and will check back in after 45m.

incidents-bot: Incident thread updated: /incidents/1729998888 — tags: embeddings, kv-cache, eu-west, customer-impact

Jamie K.: 15m check-in: smoke tests: 0/20 errors, avg latency 0.72s, but spike observed at t+9m (p99 1.3s) correlating with short GC on eu-14. Continuing to monitor.

Mike O.: ping me if you want me to increase standby capacity. If rollback begins, I'll coordinate.

Sophie L.: back briefly — thanks for taking point @Jamie K. I'll re-assume after 45m unless you request extended coverage.

Jamie K.: all good for now. I'll escalate if trend worsens.
